purpose: Link selected options/data points to source explanations and values using existing client components.

scope.selectionPersistence: Client-local; resets on reopen/restart. Source records remain unchanged.
scope.selectionData: Original source row only; no calculation or generated explanation on selection.
scope.sourcePrompts: Four structured cases: one short conclusion plus a source Markdown table for A-C; one sentence for D. Main answer generation was asked not to search or call tools.

primaryCases.source: Redis, Memcached, process-local cache; persistence, shared instances, usage
primaryCases.result: Comparison selector generated. Mouse selected Memcached; Tab and Space selected process-local cache. Detail heading and all three raw fields changed together.
Two-series line chart. Q4 dropdown showed 1700 / 2000 with original unit headers; keyboard focus on Q3 showed 1500 / 1600. Legend hide retained the complete source row.
2023 selection showed 未公布; stored series contained null and rendered a visible gap. 2020 selection preserved -3.2 and source unit.
One plain sentence; no interactive view. Four turns and four main generation steps produced exactly three views.

history.restartRestored: All three supplementary case views restored; selection reset to Redis / Q1 / 2020. Prior comparison history also gained selection without regeneration.

limitations: Real UI validation used smart-auto on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 macOS. Inline-stream and DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 were not run in the app this round.

Source explanations are displayed verbatim and are not recomputed recommendations. The supplementary official-model missing-data answer said continuous growth despite the 2023 gap; the plugin preserves that source wording and the missing-data gap. The primary OpenCode Go conclusion explicitly mentioned that 2023 was unpublished.
No new frontend testing framework or dependency was added; existing 130 automated tests and 28 assertions against the actual native DSH UI cover this round.
Raw AX snapshots and screenshots remain local evidence and are not included in the commit.
